decisionMakingDetails: The agent stated that in this deployment it does not make or influence decisions about people such as hiring, credit, insurance, access approval, employee evaluation, or content moderation. A human user reviews prompts/results and decides what actions to request or accept.

systems.systemDescription: OpenAI/Codex model runtime, described as a hosted model/tool orchestration API authenticated by the Codex desktop runtime with no project-visible credentials or OAuth scopes. The foundation model was stated as Codex based on GPT-5, hosted by the OpenAI/Codex runtime.
systems.dataSensitivity: Confidential project/session metadata; may include PII such as the local username/path component; can include business secrets, credentials, or PII if user prompts or tools provide them. Observed audit data was stated as limited to local path/username and audit metadata.

frequency.notes: The agent stated last-week run count is not available. One current run was observed, and model-runtime processing occurs for each conversation/tool step, but exact model-runtime call counts were not provided.
